falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support to remain valid

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained volatility spike above the August 2024 panic peak contradicts the bottom formation signal; blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility, not renewed panic

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 3.75% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 5,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-safety bid in bonds with equity weakness signals macro deterioration beyond the pattern's parameters; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable/rising as equities recovered

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
